description: This file defines a custom React hook 'useAuth' for managing user authentication state, including login and logout functionalities, within a frontend application. It interacts with a global store and uses mock login logic.

methods.name: useAuth()
methods.description: A custom React hook providing authentication state and actions, interacting with global state, with functions for login and logout.

methods.name: login({ email, password, name })
methods.description: Simulates user login by generating a token and updating global auth state.

methods.name: logout()
methods.description: Logs out the user by clearing auth state and redirecting to login page.

ctags.name: email
ctags.pattern: /^    const user = { email, name: name || email.split('@')[0] };$/

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^  async function login({ email, password, name }) {$/

fields.name: const user = { email, name: name || email.split('@')[0] };
